item.text: {"candidates":[{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Window counting followed by DISTINCT returns one row per hour, including the NULL hour group, while retaining COUNT(*)'s BIGINT type.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)) AS trips FROM trips"},{"query_id":"q01","reason":"Enumerates distinct hours and counts matching rows with NULL-safe equality, preserving the NULL group and duplicate counts.","sql":"WITH hours AS (SELECT DISTINCT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour FROM trips) SELECT h.hour AS hour, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trips AS t WHERE EXTRACT(hour FROM t.tpep_pickup_datetime) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM h.hour) AS trips FROM hours AS h"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Moves the original day predicate into a filtered aggregate and removes groups with no qualifying rows, preserving route NULLs and BIGINT counts.","sql":"SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY PULocationID, DOLocationID HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) > 0"},{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Applies the unchanged calendar-day predicate before window counting, then deduplicates route results while preserving NULL keys and duplicate input counts.","sql":"SELECT DISTINCT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY PULocationID, DOLocationID) AS trips FROM trips WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7"}]}
